model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models, comparing the performance of a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) with models fine-tuned on specific medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, categorized into six groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the vertical axis represents the negative log probability, ranging from -27 to -22 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1. Each group of bars corresponds to a per-specialty term and contains five bars representing the base model and the models fine-tuned on different specialties, indicated by different colors: Cardio (light orange), Gastro (orange), Infect (light brown), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars are grouped by per-specialty terms, with each group showing the negative log probability for the base model and the fine-tuned models, and the height of the bars varies across the different models and per-specialty terms. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, but within each group, the bars are arranged in a consistent order corresponding to the color legend, with the base model represented by a blue bar. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of how fine-tuning on different medical specialties affects the negative log probability of per-specialty terms.
